1.name: Bestial Bond
1.description: Appeal to the sense of a target beast, bonding it to your side.

1.name: Call Companion
1.description: Beckon to your pet, calling it to your side.

1.name: Enraging Strike I
1.description: Strike your target in a furious rage, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the Strength, Dexterity, and Agility of both you and your pet by 2 for 30 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.stat: Agility of both you and your pet

1.name: Revive Companion
1.description: Rally your pet, returning it to life and restoring 20% Health.

1.name: Fear Beast
1.description: Fears an enemy beast, causing them to run away in terror. Doing damage has a small chance to break this effect early.

2.name: Predatory Instinct
2.description: Awaken the hunter's instinct in your group, increasing their Offense by 5 and Agility by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60). This ability persists until canceled.
2.valuesSummary: +1–15 Offense by 5 and Agility (L1–L60) · +1–15 Agility (L1–L60) · +5 Offense

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Guardian Spirit
4.description: Invoke your pet's guardian spirit, reducing their Physical Damage received by 10% and the cooldown of their Provoke ability by 25% for 1 hour.

4.name: Lull Minor Beast
4.description: Lull a target Beast, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. This spell is limited to beasts up to level 22.

4.name: Sooth Companion
4.description: Soothe your pet, restoring 10 Health and an additional 10 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

5.name: Lick Wounds
5.description: Pause to mend your wounds, restoring 5% Health at the cost of 5 (L1) to 50 (L60) Mana every second over 4 seconds. This ability is channeled.

5.name: Savage Strike I
5.description: Savagely strike your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 15 (L10) Physical Damage. Additionally, this gains a damage bonus if the target is bleeding. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

6.name: Pounce
6.description: Leap toward your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the movement speed of your pet by 75% for 10 seconds.

7.name: Chop I
7.description: Viciously chop your target, dealing 120% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L7) to 15 (L17) Physical Damage, and creating an opening that causes your pet to land Critical Hits for 5 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

8.name: Remedy Companion
8.description: Remedy your pet, restoring 20 Health and an additional 20 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

8.name: Savage Spirit
8.description: Awaken a savage spirit within your pet, increasing their Attack Speed by 10% and granting them a chance to activate Rip of melee attacks for 1 hour. Rip: Rip the flesh of your target, dealing 10 Physical Damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds.

9.name: Maul I
9.description: Violently maul your target, dealing 60% Weapon Ratio Damage per equipped weapon and decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 5% for 5 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.
